## Idea

An {{#concept "ideal generated by an element" Disambiguation="commutative semiring" Agda=ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring}} `x` of a [commutative semiring](commutative-algebra.commutative-semirings.md) `R` is the [ideal generated by the subset](commutative-algebra.ideals-generated-by-subsets-commutative-semirings.md) containing only the element `x`. In other words, the ideal generated by `x` is the least [ideal](commutative-algebra.ideals-commutative-semirings.md) that contains the element `x`. In informal writing, the ideal generated by the element `x` is denoted by `⟨x⟩`.

*Remark 1.* We note that ideals generated by an element need not be [subtractive](commutative-algebra.subtractive-ideals-commutative-semirings.md). For instance, consider the commutative semiring `R := {0,1,∞}` with addition and multiplication tables given by

```text
  + | 0 1 ∞    × | 0 1 ∞
  ---------    ---------
  0 | 0 1 ∞    0 | 0 0 0
  1 | 1 ∞ ∞    1 | 0 1 ∞
  ∞ | ∞ ∞ ∞    ∞ | 0 ∞ ∞
```

Then the ideal `⟨∞⟩ = {0,∞}` generated by `∞` is not subtractive, since two out of three of `∞ + 1 = ∞` are in the ideal `⟨∞⟩`, but `1 ∉ ⟨∞⟩`.

## Definitions

### The predicate of being an ideal generated by an element

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 : Level} (R : Commutative-Semiring l1) (x : type-Commutative-Semiring R)
  (J : ideal-Commutative-Semiring l2 R)
  where

  is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    UUω
  is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( x)
      ( J)

  contains-element-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring →
    is-in-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R J x
  contains-element-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    contains-element-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( x)
      ( J)

  leq-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring →
    {l3 : Level}
    (K : ideal-Commutative-Semiring l3 R)
    (k : is-in-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R K x) →
    leq-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R J K
  leq-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    leq-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( x)
      ( J)
```

### The ideal generated by an element of a commutative semiring

```agda
module _
  {l1 : Level} (R : Commutative-Semiring l1) (x : type-Commutative-Semiring R)
  where

  generating-subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    subset-Commutative-Semiring l1 R
  generating-subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    subtype-standard-singleton-subtype
      ( set-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( x)

  ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    ideal-Commutative-Semiring l1 R
  ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring R generating-subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    subset-Commutative-Semiring l1 R
  subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    subset-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  is-in-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    type-Commutative-Semiring R → UU l1
  is-in-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-in-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  is-prop-is-in-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    (r : type-Commutative-Semiring R) → is-prop (is-in-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring r)
  is-prop-is-in-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-prop-is-in-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  type-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring : UU l1
  type-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    type-subset-Commutative-Semiring R subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  inclusion-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    type-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring → type-Commutative-Semiring R
  inclusion-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    inclusion-subset-Commutative-Semiring R subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  ap-inclusion-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    (y z : type-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring) → y ＝ z →
    inclusion-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring y ＝
    inclusion-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring z
  ap-inclusion-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    ap-inclusion-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  is-in-subset-inclusion-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    (y : type-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring) →
    is-in-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring
      ( inclusion-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring y)
  is-in-subset-inclusion-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-in-subset-inclusion-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  is-closed-under-eq-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    {y z : type-Commutative-Semiring R} →
    is-in-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring y →
    (y ＝ z) → is-in-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring z
  is-closed-under-eq-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-eq-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  is-closed-under-eq-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring' :
    {y z : type-Commutative-Semiring R} →
    is-in-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring z →
    (y ＝ z) → is-in-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring y
  is-closed-under-eq-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring' =
    is-closed-under-eq-ideal-Commutative-Semiring' R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  is-ideal-subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring R subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring
  is-ideal-subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-ideal-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  is-additive-submonoid-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-additive-submonoid-subset-Commutative-Semiring R
      subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring
  is-additive-submonoid-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-additive-submonoid-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  contains-zero-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-in-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring (zero-Commutative-Semiring R)
  contains-zero-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    contains-zero-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  is-closed-under-addition-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-closed-under-addition-subset-Commutative-Semiring R
      subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring
  is-closed-under-addition-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-addition-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  is-closed-under-left-multiplication-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-closed-under-left-multiplication-subset-Commutative-Semiring R
      subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring
  is-closed-under-left-multiplication-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-left-multiplication-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R
      ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  is-closed-under-right-multiplication-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-closed-under-right-multiplication-subset-Commutative-Semiring R
      subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring
  is-closed-under-right-multiplication-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-right-multiplication-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R
      ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  is-closed-under-two-sided-multiplication-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-closed-under-two-sided-multiplication-subset-Commutative-Semiring R
      subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring
  is-closed-under-two-sided-multiplication-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-two-sided-multiplication-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R
      ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  additive-submonoid-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    Submonoid l1 (additive-monoid-Commutative-Semiring R)
  additive-submonoid-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    additive-submonoid-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring

  contains-element-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-in-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring x
  contains-element-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring =
    contains-subset-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring R
      ( generating-subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring)
      ( x)
      ( refl)

  leq-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    {l3 : Level} (I : ideal-Commutative-Semiring l3 R) →
    is-in-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R I x →
    leq-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring I
  leq-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring I H =
    leq-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring R
      ( generating-subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring)
      ( I)
      ( λ { x refl → H})

  abstract
    is-ideal-generated-by-element-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
      is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring R x
        ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring
    is-ideal-generated-by-element-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring J =
      is-least-subtype-containing-element-standard-singleton-subtype-Set
        ( set-Commutative-Semiring R)
        ( x)
        ( subset-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R J) ∘iff
      is-ideal-generated-by-subset-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring R
        ( generating-subset-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring)
        ( J)
```

## Properties

### Any two ideals generated by the same element contain the same elements

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 : Level} (R : Commutative-Semiring l1) (x : type-Commutative-Semiring R)
  (J : ideal-Commutative-Semiring l2 R)
  (U : is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring R x J)
  (K : ideal-Commutative-Semiring l3 R)
  (V : is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring R x K)
  where

  has-same-elements-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    has-same-elements-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R J K
  pr1 (has-same-elements-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring r) =
    leq-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring R x J U K
      ( contains-element-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring
        R x K V)
      ( r)
  pr2 (has-same-elements-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring r) =
    leq-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring R x K V J
      ( contains-element-is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring
        R x J U)
      ( r)
```

### Any ideal that has the same elements as the ideal generated by an element `x` satisfies the universal property of the ideal generated by the element `x`

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 : Level} (R : Commutative-Semiring l1) (x : type-Commutative-Semiring R)
  (J : ideal-Commutative-Semiring l2 R)
  where

  is-ideal-generated-by-element-has-same-elements-Commutative-Semiring :
    has-same-elements-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R
      ( ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring R x)
      ( J) →
    is-ideal-generated-by-element-Commutative-Semiring R x J
  is-ideal-generated-by-element-has-same-elements-Commutative-Semiring H K =
    logical-equivalence-reasoning
      leq-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R J K
      ↔ leq-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R (ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring R x) K
        by
        iff-Π-iff-family
          ( λ y →
            ( λ f → f ∘ forward-implication (H y)) ,
            ( λ f → f ∘ backward-implication (H y)))
      ↔ is-in-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R K x
        by
        is-ideal-generated-by-element-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring
          R x K
```

### The ideal `⟨x⟩` is trivial if and only if `x ＝ 0`

```agda
module _
  {l1 : Level} (R : Commutative-Semiring l1) (x : type-Commutative-Semiring R)
  where

  is-trivial-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-zero-Commutative-Semiring R x →
    is-trivial-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R (ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring R x)
  is-trivial-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring p =
    is-trivial-leq-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R
      ( ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring R x)
      ( trivial-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( is-trivial-trivial-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( leq-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring R x
        ( trivial-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R)
        ( is-closed-under-eq-trivial-ideal-Commutative-Semiring' R
          ( contains-zero-trivial-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R)
          ( p)))

  is-zero-is-trivial-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-trivial-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R (ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring R x) →
    is-zero-Commutative-Semiring R x
  is-zero-is-trivial-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring H =
    H (contains-element-ideal-element-Commutative-Semiring R x)
```
